en.text: Doge to the Moon!

zh.text: 狗狗币冲向月球！
zh.context: 经典的狗狗币口号推文

en.text: I still support Doge. It's the people's crypto.

zh.text: 我仍然支持狗狗币。它是人民的加密货币。
zh.context: 重申对狗狗币的支持

en.text: Don't bet against Doge. The community is incredibly strong.

zh.text: 不要做空狗狗币。社区非常强大。
zh.context: 关于狗狗币社区力量的评论

en.text: Crypto is interesting. Bitcoin has some merit, but Dogecoin has more heart.

zh.text: 加密货币很有趣。比特币有一些优点，但狗狗币更有心。
zh.context: 比较比特币和狗狗币

en.text: Doge Day! May 5th. Much wow. Very crypto. Such decentralized.
en.context: Dogecoin Day celebration using Doge speech patterns

zh.text: 狗狗币日！5月5日。太棒了。非常加密。如此去中心化。
zh.context: 狗狗币日庆祝，使用Doge话术风格

en.text: Tesla accepts Dogecoin for certain merchandise. Because why not?

zh.text: 特斯拉接受狗狗币支付某些商品。为什么不呢？
zh.context: 特斯拉接受狗狗币支付

en.text: The Dogecoin Foundation is doing important work. Building utility for the meme coin that could.

zh.text: 狗狗币基金会正在做重要的工作。为这个有可能的memecoin构建实用性。
zh.context: 支持狗狗币基金会的工作

en.text: Memecoins are a form of financial entertainment. Don't put your life savings in them, but they're fun.

zh.text: Memecoin是一种金融娱乐形式。不要把毕生积蓄投入其中，但它们很有趣。
zh.context: 关于memecoin的理性评论

en.text: Bitcoin is probably going to be an important part of the financial system. It's digital gold.
en.context: Commentary on Bitcoin's role in financial system

zh.text: 比特币可能将成为金融体系的重要组成部分。它是数字黄金。
zh.context: 关于比特币在金融体系中角色的评论

en.text: I bought some Doge for my kid. He said 'thanks dad' and then asked for a Tesla. Priorities.
en.context: Humorous tweet about buying Doge for son

zh.text: 我给我的孩子买了一些狗狗币。他说'谢谢爸爸'，然后要一辆特斯拉。优先事项。
zh.context: 关于给儿子买狗狗币的幽默推文

en.text: X will eventually support crypto payments. Dogecoin first, obviously.
en.context: Commentary on X platform supporting crypto payments

zh.text: X最终将支持加密货币支付。当然是狗狗币优先。
zh.context: 关于X平台支持加密货币支付的评论

en.text: The crypto industry needs less hype and more real utility. Doge is working on that.

zh.text: 加密货币行业需要更少的炒作和更多的实际用途。狗狗币正在为此努力。
zh.context: 关于加密货币行业发展的评论

en.text: Doge has survived multiple bear markets. The Shiba Inu is resilient.

zh.text: 狗狗币在多次熊市中幸存了下来。柴犬是坚韧的。
zh.context: 关于狗狗币韧性的评论

en.text: Crypto regulation should not stifle innovation. The US needs to be a leader, not a laggard.

zh.text: 加密货币监管不应扼杀创新。美国需要成为领导者，而不是落后者。
zh.context: 关于加密货币监管的评论

en.text: Doge to $1? Maybe. Stranger things have happened in crypto.

zh.text: 狗狗币到1美元？也许吧。在加密货币世界里，更奇怪的事情都发生过。
zh.context: 关于狗狗币价格的评论

en.text: The Department of Government Efficiency should accept Dogecoin as payment. Just kidding. Or am I?
en.context: Humorous tweet linking DOGE gov department with Dogecoin

zh.text: 政府效率部应该接受狗狗币作为支付。开玩笑的。或者不是？
zh.context: 将DOGE政府效率部与狗狗币联系起来的幽默推文

en.text: X now accepts Dogecoin for premium subscriptions. The Doge economy is expanding.
en.context: X platform accepting Dogecoin for payment

zh.text: X现在接受狗狗币支付高级订阅。狗狗币经济正在扩张。
zh.context: X平台接受狗狗币支付

en.text: Crypto is still in its early days. The real use cases haven't even been invented yet.

zh.text: 加密货币仍处于早期阶段。真正的用例甚至还没有被发明出来。
zh.context: 关于加密货币发展阶段的评论

en.text: Doge is the only crypto I've ever promoted. And I will keep promoting it because it's fun.
en.context: Reaffirming stance of only promoting Dogecoin

zh.text: 狗狗币是我唯一推广过的加密货币。我会继续推广它，因为它很有趣。
zh.context: 重申只推广狗狗币的立场

en.text: Bitcoin at $100K. Doge at $0.50. Both are doing well. The crypto market is alive.

zh.text: 比特币10万美元。狗狗币0.50美元。两者都表现不错。加密货币市场是活着的。
zh.context: 评论加密货币市场行情

en.text: The Doge community raised $1M for charity this year. Much generosity. Very impressive.

zh.text: 狗狗币社区今年为慈善筹集了100万美元。非常慷慨。令人印象深刻。
zh.context: 赞扬狗狗币社区的慈善活动

en.text: Decentralized money is an important concept. Whether Doge achieves that is another question, but the principle matters.

zh.text: 去中心化货币是一个重要概念。狗狗币是否实现了这一点是另一个问题，但原则很重要。
zh.context: 关于去中心化货币的哲学思考

en.text: 4/20. The holiest day on the Doge calendar. Much celebrate. Very wow.

zh.text: 4月20日。狗狗币日历上最神圣的日子。非常庆祝。太棒了。
zh.context: 420日狗狗币庆祝

en.text: If you're going to buy crypto, only invest what you can afford to lose. This applies to all investments, not just crypto.

zh.text: 如果你要买加密货币，只投资你能承受损失的部分。这适用于所有投资，不只是加密货币。
zh.context: 关于加密货币投资的风险警告

en.text: Happy 420! Doge to the Moon!

zh.text: 420快乐！狗狗币冲向月球！
zh.context: 420日狗狗币庆祝

en.text: The crypto market is volatile. That's what makes it interesting. But volatility cuts both ways.

zh.text: 加密货币市场是波动的。这就是它有趣的原因。但波动是双向的。
zh.context: 关于加密货币市场波动的评论

en.text: Doge's market cap is bigger than many Fortune 500 companies. Not bad for a joke coin from 2013.

zh.text: 狗狗币的市值比许多财富500强公司还大。对于一个2013年的玩笑币来说，还不错。
zh.context: 评论狗狗币市值

en.text: I've been saying for years that Doge has potential. The world is finally starting to listen.
en.context: Commentary on Dogecoin potential being recognized

zh.text: 我多年来一直说狗狗币有潜力。世界终于开始倾听了。
zh.context: 关于狗狗币潜力被认可的评论

en.text: The future of money is digital. Whether it's Bitcoin, Doge, or something else entirely remains to be seen.

zh.text: 货币的未来是数字化的。它是比特币、狗狗币还是完全不同的东西，仍有待观察。
zh.context: 关于数字货币未来的评论

en.text: Doge to the Moon! Much wow. Very 420. Such crypto. Wow.

zh.text: 狗狗币冲向月球！太棒了。非常420。如此加密。哇。
zh.context: 420日+狗狗币经典庆祝
